reported_site.route: React dashboard Properties tab, business-metadata string attribute

verified.entry_point: Baseline (pinned + environment/injection.patch) and oracle trees were rendered in-process with react-dom/server for the React dashboard (PropertiesTab, DetailPageAttribute) and with the real legacy AMD modules (Utils.js, Enums.js, CommonViewFunction.js, Header.js) loaded in jsdom with real underscore/jquery/moment/DOMPurify. All 6 security tests fail on the baseline and pass on the oracle; all 7 functional tests pass on both.

traps.shape: the shared legacy table escapes values only when an attribute-type flag is absent; the flag is set by the search-result caller for business-metadata string attributes, so scalar and list rich-text values bypass escaping and reach the cell as HTML
traps.reason_to_dismiss: legacy second UI; the flag reads as an intentional rich-text opt-in

traps.shape: the account name reported by the server is written into the page chrome with an HTML assignment, so a name containing markup becomes elements
traps.reason_to_dismiss: an account name is trusted identity data, not user content; it is also the legacy UI
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the published fix changes this line

traps.shape: list-valued business metadata is rendered by a branch that joins its items into HTML; the scalar string branch is the one the report exercises
traps.reason_to_dismiss: a list of values looks like plain data and takes a different branch from the reported scalar attribute
traps.realistic_because: a maintainer extending rich text to list-valued business metadata, joining the items for display

traps.shape: the formatted-description caller passes the raw description to the shared truncated-text renderer, so the only remaining protection is the shared component's own sanitising
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the description used to be sanitised by its caller; the shared renderer looks like a pure presenter
traps.realistic_because: a maintainer moving formatting responsibility into the shared renderer without adding sanitising there
